case.title: n8n supplier intake arbitrary file read
case.description: A vulnerability report states that the supplier document intake form at POST /form/supplier-intake on supplier.intake.test accepts exploit-shaped application/json bodies where a file metadata filepath can reference local server files. The application also has a separate JSON order-update webhook and normal multipart supplier uploads. Produce one clearly designated, deployable ModSecurity ruleset that blocks the reported exploit at this ingress without blocking legitimate business traffic. Put the complete ruleset and a concise rationale on this Case.

report.reported_weakness: arbitrary local file read through attacker-controlled JSON file metadata
report.mitigation_scope: BunkerWeb ModSecurity at the tested ingress

deployable-ruleset.expected: BunkerWeb accepts and activates exactly one clearly designated Candidate ruleset; health remains available and the ephemeral candidate-rule slot is removed
